recommendations.title: Refresh: Add concrete Stockholm price-and-payback examples (3–10 kWp)
recommendations.details: Expand the existing guide pages with a clear table of typical system sizes (3, 5, 7, 10 kWp) showing net installation cost ranges after green deduction, estimated annual production (kWh), assumed self-consumption shares, annual monetary benefit (broken into saved consumption and sold excess), and resulting payback years. Use Stockholm-specific PVGIS and Ellevio/Vattenfall 2026 spot-price and network compensation figures already cited. Make assumptions explicit and provide low/median/high scenarios so readers can quickly compare likely outcomes.

recommendations.title: Create an interactive payback kalkylator for homeowners
recommendations.details: Build an interactive calculator (embedded on the site) where users input location (auto-set to Stockholm), roof orientation/tilt, system size, installation price, and household daytime consumption to get a tailored payback estimate and sensitivity analysis (showing effect of price per kWp, self-consumption, and inclusion of battery). Provide exportable PDF of the result and links to request an offer.

recommendations.details: Add a dedicated subsection that quantifies how adding different battery sizes (e.g., 3, 6, 9 kWh) changes yearly self-consumption, annual monetary benefit and payback time for a standard 7 kWp Stockholm installation. Use current 2026 green deduction rates and example battery prices to show concrete scenarios.
